text: FAA guidance: reestablish the control link if possible; if not, enact loss-of-control contingencies, and another remote pilot may assume control. The M30T manual states loss of signal triggers RTH after six seconds; RTH returns to the last Home Point and can be automatic, with Original Route RTH if vision or lighting is unavailable; RTH altitude must clear obstacles. Unverified incident reports claim the forum reported RTH without warning and that the aircraft landed at its home point with live video visible and stick inputs ineffective. Main gap: the forum claim of no warning conflicts with the manual’s triggers and sequencing, leaving unresolved linkage to FAA guidance and whether Original Route RTH applied.
